findings.title: beta-qualify.sh executes the candidate repo's config-declared `verify=` by default, with no trust acknowledgement
a symlinked `--output` inside `--repo` leaves harness-created directories in the target it refuses to write to
adding the rehearsal to tests/run.sh makes release.sh re-run it inside the extracted archive, where the source-checkout snapshots pass vacuously
the `--uninstall` symlink assertions use `[ -e ]`, which is false for a dangling symlink
